title: Taxpayer portal live submissions list and status
scope: Replace the fixture submissions list, submission detail and session labels in the taxpayer portal with live Frappe data, including the taxpayer-safe status mirrored from Jube by TAX-039

acceptance.text: get_submissions and get_submission read Vati Submission/Refund Claim records for the signed-in taxpayer with mode live; the session is labelled live; the fixture notice appears only in fixture mode
A claim the taxpayer submits appears in their list with its current taxpayer-safe status; another taxpayer's submissions are never visible; internal risk details are never shown
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: A claim the taxpayer submits appears in their list with its current taxpayer-safe status; another taxpayer's submissions are never visible; internal risk details are never shown

evidence.text: portal.api get_session/get_submissions/get_submission return mode live from the caller's own Vati Submission + Vati Refund Claim rows (portal/submissions.py view). Bench: test_session_and_lists_are_live; vitest router.test accepts live or labelled fixture only; browser: fixture notice and 'Synthetic fixture' label only in fixture mode, 'Live data' otherwise. Live HTTP: session labelled live.

Bench (frappe_dev.py verify, fresh site, 167 OK): a sent claim is listed with status under_review; mirrored evidence_requested/completed shown; taxpayer B (same tenant) and C (other tenant) never see it and get not found; payload has no case/risk/Jube/finding/tenant detail and only allowlisted keys. Live HTTP on the isolated stack 16/16 (REF-2026-000017, 404 for B and C, 403 guest, mirrored statuses). Browser: a claim sent in the portal appears first as Under review at 3 widths.
